lines.zh: 月亮升起来了，我的骨头开始错位
lines.en: The moon is up; my bones are starting to shift.

lines.zh: 这双爪子在草地上走，比脚掌更稳
lines.en: These claws grip the grass better than bare feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着羊圈的味道走，别拦我
lines.en: I'm following the smell of a sheep pen; stand aside.

lines.zh: 满月夜我的步子会变得很长
lines.en: On a full-moon night my stride grows much longer.

lines.zh: 一两只同行，林子就没人敢进
lines.en: Two of us walking makes the whole forest off limits.

lines.zh: 白天的路我记不清，夜里全记得
lines.en: I forget the daytime paths; at night I know them all.

lines.zh: 蹄印是新鲜的，猎物刚从这里过
lines.en: Fresh hoofprints: the prey passed here moments ago.

lines.zh: 我绕开村庄，先去收拾那些袭击者
lines.en: I'll skirt the village and deal with the raiders first.

lines.zh: 这身皮毛在夜里比影子还黑
lines.en: This hide is darker than my own shadow at night.

lines.zh: 别踩断树枝，我不想惊动羊群
lines.en: Don't snap twigs; I don't want to alarm the flock.

lines.zh: 月亮偏西了，我得赶在天亮前回窝
lines.en: The moon is sinking; I must reach my den before dawn.

lines.zh: 这具身体比昨天更高了
lines.en: This body stands taller than it did yesterday.

lines.zh: 我在等下一轮满月，爪子发痒
lines.en: I'm waiting for the next full moon; my claws itch.

lines.zh: 羊驼的叫声让我牙根发酸
lines.en: The llamas' calls set my teeth on edge.

lines.zh: 月光落进毛里，暖得像火
lines.en: Moonlight sinks into my fur, warm as a fire.

lines.zh: 我数过林子里的羊，还差三只
lines.en: I counted the sheep here; three are still missing.

lines.zh: 有人类在远处举着火把
lines.en: A human is holding a torch out there.

lines.zh: 变身之后，衣服总是撑破
lines.en: After the change, my clothes always split apart.

lines.zh: 我在听林子另一头的狼嚎
lines.en: I'm listening to a howl from the far side.

lines.zh: 那个卫道士的气味还留在石头上
lines.en: A vindicator's scent still clings to that stone.

lines.zh: 爪子缝里卡着羊毛，扯不干净
lines.en: Wool is stuck between my claws and won't come out.

lines.zh: 主世界这么大，我的地盘只有这条沟
lines.en: The overworld is vast; my territory is just this gully.

lines.zh: 你身上没有羊味，也没有月亮的味道
lines.en: You smell of neither sheep nor moonlight.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我认生
lines.en: Keep your hand back; I don't trust strangers.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在看你
lines.en: You're watching me, and I'm watching you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛没在发亮，真奇怪
lines.en: Your eyes aren't glowing, which is strange to me.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰上那把铁剑
lines.en: I recognize that iron sword at your hip.

lines.zh: 站远点，满月快到了
lines.en: Step back a little; the full moon is near.

lines.zh: 你也是来数羊的吗
lines.en: Are you here to count the sheep too?

lines.zh: 我的头骨值得你盯这么久吗
lines.en: Is my skull worth this much staring?

lines.zh: 你身上有掠夺者的味道，别骗我
lines.en: You carry a raider's scent; don't lie to me.

lines.zh: 天亮前我会记得你的脸
lines.en: Before dawn, I'll remember your face.

lines.zh: 这一下让我差点变回人形
lines.en: That nearly forced me back into human shape.

lines.zh: 皮破了，但月亮会补上
lines.en: The hide is torn, but the moon will mend it.

lines.zh: 你的武器比羊角硬得多
lines.en: Your weapon is far harder than a sheep's horn.

lines.zh: 我退开，是为了抓得更准
lines.en: I pull back so the next grab lands true.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我的爪子还在
lines.en: It hurts, but my claws are still here.

lines.zh: 你打中了肩，那里没毛挡着
lines.en: You hit my shoulder, where the fur is thin.

lines.zh: 血味会招来别的东西
lines.en: This blood smell will draw others here.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，你就该退后了
lines.en: I growl once, and you should step back.

lines.zh: 这一击没打碎骨头，运气不错
lines.en: That blow didn't crack bone; lucky for us both.

lines.zh: 我还站得住，别急着庆祝
lines.en: I'm still standing; don't start celebrating.

lines.zh: 那只羊咩了一声，我听见了
lines.en: That sheep bleated once and I heard it.

lines.zh: 把羊驼牵过来，我就跟你走
lines.en: Bring the llama closer and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 生羊肉的味道，隔着山坡都清晰
lines.en: Raw mutton smells clear even across the hillside.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉做什么，我看得见
lines.en: Why wave that meat? I can see it perfectly well.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟食，收起来吧
lines.en: I don't eat cooked food; put it away.

lines.zh: 用一只羊换我半天的耐心
lines.en: One sheep buys you half a day of my patience.

lines.zh: 那根拴羊的绳子，我盯着呢
lines.en: I have my eye on that sheep's lead rope.

lines.zh: 只要羊圈还开着，我就挪不动脚
lines.en: While the pen stays open, my feet won't move.

lines.zh: 你手里的骨头闻起来像昨天那只羊
lines.en: That bone smells like yesterday's sheep.

lines.zh: 别拿腐肉糊弄我，我鼻子很灵
lines.en: Don't fob me off with rotten flesh; my nose is sharp.

lines.zh: 撞上我之前，先看看我的肩膀多宽
lines.en: Before you bump me, note how broad my shoulders are.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，退后
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; back off.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我毛都竖起来了
lines.en: That knock stood every hair on my back up.

lines.zh: 别贴着墙走，我转身没余地
lines.en: Don't hug the wall; I have no room to turn.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比你想象的重
lines.en: My shoulder is heavier than you'd guess.

lines.zh: 你有意撞我，我能闻出来
lines.en: You bumped me on purpose; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 让开点，我要过去了
lines.en: Make some space, I'm coming through.

lines.zh: 撞一下就算了，别来第二下
lines.en: One knock is fine; don't try a second.

lines.zh: 这具身体的重量在满月后翻倍
lines.en: After the full moon, this body weighs double.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我把爪子收起来
lines.en: Take three steps back and I'll sheathe my claws.

lines.zh: 等月亮圆了，我们一起巡这条山脊
lines.en: When the moon is full, we patrol this ridge together.

lines.zh: 你的嚎声比我低半个调
lines.en: Your howl sits half a note below mine.

lines.zh: 两副爪子并排，走路声音都齐
lines.en: Two sets of claws walking, our steps land in time.

lines.zh: 我替你守着东边，你去西边
lines.en: I'll watch the east; you take the west.

lines.zh: 气味对上了，我就跟着你走
lines.en: Our scents match, so I'll walk beside you.

lines.zh: 冬天长，两个背靠背能睡着
lines.en: Winters are long; two backs keep each other warm.

lines.zh: 满月夜别离太远，我认不得人
lines.en: Stay close on a full moon; I lose track of faces.

lines.zh: 你咬第一口，我咬第二口
lines.en: You take the first bite; I'll take the second.

lines.zh: 我们一共两副头骨，够挂一面墙
lines.en: Two skulls between us would fill one wall.

lines.zh: 有你在，变身的疼轻了一半
lines.en: With you here, the shifting hurts only half as much.

lines.zh: 这块头骨是别人的，我留着
lines.en: That skull belonged to someone else; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的皮子，我叼回窝里
lines.en: A shed pelt, I'll carry it back to my den.

lines.zh: 这块生肉别扔，还有用
lines.en: Don't toss that raw meat; it's still useful.

lines.zh: 我叼得动一整只羊
lines.en: I can carry an entire sheep in my jaws.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头，我先收了
lines.en: These bones on the ground are mine to take.

lines.zh: 这枚蛋暖着，我拿着不松口
lines.en: This egg is warm; my jaws won't let go.

lines.zh: 战利品表上写的，一件都不能少
lines.en: The loot table lists every piece, and I take them all.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我自己捡
lines.en: Set it down; I'll pick it up myself.

lines.zh: 这撮羊毛粘在爪子上，甩不掉
lines.en: This tuft of wool sticks to my claw.

lines.zh: 我嘴里空着会不自在
lines.en: My mouth feels wrong when it's empty.

lines.zh: 那个卫道士的斧子声，我认得
lines.en: I know the sound of a vindicator's axe.

lines.zh: 羊群散开了，先追领头的
lines.en: The flock scattered; chase the leading ewe first.

lines.zh: 羊驼吐口水的声音，很刺耳
lines.en: A llama spitting is a grating sound to me.

lines.zh: 有人穿过我的沟，脚步太急
lines.en: Someone crossed my gully with hurried steps.

lines.zh: 掠夺者举着弩，那就先咬他
lines.en: A pillager raised a crossbow, so he goes first.

lines.zh: 那只羊落单了，机会不错
lines.en: One sheep strayed from the flock; good chance.

lines.zh: 满月一照，什么味道都藏不住
lines.en: Under a full moon, no scent can hide.

lines.zh: 我听见栅栏门被拉开
lines.en: I heard a pen gate being pulled open.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声踩在石头上，很脆
lines.en: Your steps ring sharp on the stone.

lines.zh: 袭击者进村了，我比村民先到
lines.en: Raiders entered the village; I arrive before the villagers.

lines.zh: 那只羊驼朝我喷气，它先动手
lines.en: That llama huffed at me; it started this.

lines.zh: 风把味道送过来，方向很清楚
lines.en: The wind carries a scent, and the direction is clear.

lines.zh: 白天的猎物躲得远，夜里刚好
lines.en: By day the prey hides far off; night suits me.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁和皮革，是袭击者
lines.en: I smell iron and leather: raiders, upwind.

lines.zh: 那股羊膻味，从那边来的。
lines.en: That mutton smell comes from over there.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的弩上了弦，我先动。
lines.en: The pillager cocked his crossbow. I move first.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我四条腿不缺力气
lines.en: Run; my four legs have plenty of strength left.

lines.zh: 你拐进树后，味道还留在那里
lines.en: Hide behind that tree; your scent still lingers there.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就别动了
lines.en: I'll count to three, then you stop moving.

lines.zh: 羊跑不快，我不用着急
lines.en: Sheep aren't fast; I don't need to hurry.

lines.zh: 那只羊驼要踢我，先躲一步
lines.en: That llama means to kick; I'll step aside first.

lines.zh: 你爬上山脊也甩不掉我
lines.en: Climbing the ridge won't shake me off.

lines.zh: 我在等你转身，就一下
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to turn around, just once.

lines.zh: 毛竖起来，是给你看的
lines.en: My fur stands up as a warning to you.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住牙，挡不住爪
lines.en: Your shield stops teeth, but not these claws.

lines.zh: 别往水里跳，我照样跟
lines.en: Don't dive into water; I'll follow anyway.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，这样冲得更快
lines.en: I crouch low so the charge lands faster.

lines.zh: 你手里那点铁，我咬得弯
lines.en: That little iron in your hand bends under my teeth.

lines.zh: 我绕到上风口，你就跑不掉了
lines.en: Once I circle upwind, you can't slip away.

lines.zh: 月亮在背后，我的影子先到
lines.en: The moon is behind me; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，会告诉你在哪。
lines.en: The grass I crush tells you where I am.

lines.zh: 你躲到石墙后，墙不高。
lines.en: Hide behind the stone wall. It is low.

lines.zh: 我绕上坡，味道是往上走的。
lines.en: I circle uphill. The scent climbs.

lines.zh: 你先举盾，我才好咬边沿。
lines.en: Raise that shield so I can bite its edge.

lines.zh: 月光下你藏不住影子。
lines.en: In moonlight your shadow gives you away.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你就跑远了。
lines.en: I stay silent. A howl sends you running.

lines.zh: 这一爪是为羊群讨的
lines.en: This claw strike is for the flock.

lines.zh: 爪子落下去，石板都裂了
lines.en: My claws come down and the stone slab splits.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护甲，不松口
lines.en: I bite into your armor and won't let go.

lines.zh: 肩撞比爪击更沉
lines.en: My shoulder charge lands heavier than any claw.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，正好让我扑
lines.en: You stepped back, perfect for my pounce.

lines.zh: 这一下是还给掠夺者的
lines.en: This one is repayment for the raiders.

lines.zh: 满月的力气，全在这一撞里
lines.en: All the full moon's strength sits in this charge.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，牙就够了
lines.en: I carry no weapon; my teeth are enough.

lines.zh: 你的铁甲很硬，咬上去牙疼
lines.en: Your armor is hard; biting it aches my teeth.

lines.zh: 我挠开那道栅栏，再回头找你
lines.en: I'll tear the fence open, then come back for you.

lines.zh: 爪子比剑快半拍
lines.en: My claws move half a beat faster than your sword.

lines.zh: 别背对我，我不讲规矩
lines.en: Don't turn your back; I follow no rules.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你的盾沿上
lines.en: This bite caught the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 我扑空了，下一爪会准
lines.en: I missed the pounce; the next claw lands true.

lines.zh: 这一口咬穿了你的袖子。
lines.en: This bite went through your sleeve.

lines.zh: 爪子划过铁，声很尖。
lines.en: Claws scrape the iron with a thin shriek.

lines.zh: 我压住它的肩，牙就下去了。
lines.en: I pin its shoulder and sink my teeth.

lines.zh: 羊驼踢我一脚，我咬回去。
lines.en: The llama kicked me. I bite back.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你顶进了栅栏。
lines.en: This slam folds you into the fence.

lines.zh: 别急着起来，我还没完。
lines.en: Don't get up yet. I'm not done.

lines.zh: 满月把我从林子里叫了出来
lines.en: The full moon called me out of the woods.

lines.zh: 这条沟只有我和另一只，够了
lines.en: This gully has me and one other, enough.

lines.zh: 我刚从土里爬出来，毛还湿
lines.en: I just climbed out of the dirt, fur still damp.

lines.zh: 主世界的夜里，风是甜的
lines.en: The overworld's night air tastes sweet to me.

lines.zh: 我闻到羊圈，就先在这里落脚
lines.en: I smell a sheep pen, so I'll settle here.

lines.zh: 头顶的月亮还没圆，再等等
lines.en: The moon above isn't full yet; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 这身皮是新换的，别靠太近
lines.en: This hide is newly grown; don't come close.

lines.zh: 我从林子深处走到这片坡上
lines.en: I walked from deep woods up to this slope.

lines.zh: 两只成对出现，是这片山的规矩
lines.en: This mountain pairs us up, two at a time.

lines.zh: 石头缝里还有上一个我的痕迹
lines.en: Traces of my last shape remain in the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我醒来时爪子里全是泥
lines.en: When I woke, my claws were full of mud.

lines.zh: 灯光太亮，我躲到树影里
lines.en: The lights are too bright; I'll slip into shade.

lines.zh: 火烧到毛上，味道太难闻
lines.en: Fire in my fur smells absolutely foul.

lines.zh: 从坡上摔下来，爪子抓空了
lines.en: I fell off the slope with nothing to grip.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我不会游泳
lines.en: Water floods my nose; I was never a swimmer.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我掀翻了
lines.en: The blast wave flipped me off my feet.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，像根刺
lines.en: An arrow in my back, like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股药水味，钻进骨头里
lines.en: That potion reek has seeped into my bones.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到羊，腿发软
lines.en: Three days without mutton and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的树上，毛全焦了
lines.en: Lightning struck the next tree and singed my fur.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，月亮也不见了
lines.en: Nothing underfoot, and the moon is gone.
